answer: Require each agent to post a bond in a scarce, nontransferable work credential, then slash it when its claims fail an unpredictable audit. A newcomer earns credentials by completing tasks that established participants can verify, so copying identities does not copy reputation or bypass the bond. The attacker must acquire and risk a separate credential for every sybil, paying real effort and losing bonds on detected fraud; copper, ember, and ferrous can label audit batches, not serve as proof of identity.
